# Wiring harness installation via firewall grommet

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Slide a hand with a razor blade down the firewall to make a small nick in the grommet. [t4]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Remove the cover from the engine compartment fuse box.
2. Slide a hand with a razor blade down the firewall to make a small nick in the grommet.

_Procedure reported by [t4]._

## Parts

- Petroleum Lube, White [t4]
- Razor Blade [t4]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use white petroleum lube on the wire to reduce drag while pulling it through. [t4]
